description: This file contains shell functions related to the upgrade process for the uDPU hardware platform, specifically handling partition check, preparation, formatting, and upgrade procedures for eMMC storage, including mounting, formatting with f2fs and ext4, and firmware update steps.

methods.name: udpu_check_emmc
methods.description: Checks for the presence of eMMC storage devices and sets the device path accordingly.

methods.name: udpu_part_prep
methods.description: Prepares a specific partition by unmounting it if mounted.

methods.name: udpu_do_part_check
methods.description: Verifies the existence of required eMMC partitions, creates and formats them if missing.

methods.name: udpu_do_misc_prep
methods.description: Prepares the /misc partition for use, mounting or reformatting as necessary.

methods.name: udpu_do_initial_setup
methods.description: Initial partition setup for recovery, boot, and root filesystems.

methods.name: udpu_do_regular_upgrade
methods.description: Performs routine upgrade by cleaning the boot and root partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_uDPU
methods.description: Main upgrade function that manages firmware extraction, partition preparation, and updating of firmware on a uDPU device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_uDPU
methods.description: Copies configuration backups from the upgrade backup location to /misc to persist across reboots.
